root_cause.defect: When maxima was supplied, the helper intersected the valid interpolation domain with the maxima mask. It then required the 2 km and 4 km flank interpolation stencils themselves to consist of HGM maxima, which necessarily invalidated all samples.
root_cause.correction: Separated the center-candidate mask from the flank-sample-valid mask. The gradient normal is evaluated only at maxima; both flanks are validated against the full finite/valid basement-depth domain.

invalidated_actions: An all-zero pre-placement surface was sent through the registry comparator before the empty-surface guard existed; its apparent clearance is invalid and is not counted as a uniqueness result.
An empty candidate and zero-budget controls were passed through the holdout code path; those transient metrics are discarded and are not reported as HOLDOUT-DTI.
Strict JSON serialization failed on the no-candidate recovery diagnostic infinity; no run card, candidate TIFF, ZIP, or submission receipt was written.
follow_up: The shared helper was fixed in place, a regression test was added, and an explicit empty-surface guard plus strict-JSON normalization were added before retrying the same frozen H61U-H1 parameters.
